Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter, the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces…
But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise,
and said, “What are you willing to give me, that I should deliver him to you?” They weighed out for him thirty pieces…
They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please…

whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
translations.bsb: Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
translations.kjv: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
translations.asv: And Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils. And he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
